程序包 org.bukkit.conversations

类 ConversationFactory

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.conversations.ConversationFactory
public class ConversationFactory extends Object
A ConversationFactory is responsible for creating a Conversation from a predefined template. A ConversationFactory is typically created when a plugin is instantiated and builds a Conversation each time a user initiates a conversation with the plugin. Each Conversation maintains its own state and calls back as needed into the plugin. ConversationFactory 负责从预定义模板创建 Conversation。ConversationFactory 通常在插件实例化时创建，并在每次用户发起与插件的对话时构建一个 Conversation。每个 Conversation 维护自己的状态，并按需回调插件。

The ConversationFactory implements a fluid API, allowing parameters to be set as an extension to the constructor. ConversationFactory 实现了流式 API，允许以链式扩展构造方法的方式设置参数。

    • withModality

      public ConversationFactory withModality(boolean modal)
      Sets the modality of all Conversations created by this factory. If a conversation is modal, all messages directed to the player are suppressed for the duration of the conversation. 设置此工厂创建的所有 Conversation 的模态性。如果对话是模态的，在对话持续期间，所有发给玩家的消息都会被抑制。

      The default is True. 默认为 True。

      参数:
      modal - The modality of all conversations to be created. 要创建的所有对话的模态性。
      返回:
      This object. 本对象。

    • withLocalEcho

      public ConversationFactory withLocalEcho(boolean localEchoEnabled)
      Sets the local echo status for all Conversations created by this factory. If local echo is enabled, any text submitted to a conversation gets echoed back into the submitter's chat window. 设置此工厂创建的所有 Conversation 的本地回显状态。如果启用本地回显，提交到对话的任何文本都会回显到提交者的聊天窗口。
      参数:
      localEchoEnabled - The status of local echo. 本地回显的状态。
      返回:
      This object. 本对象。

    • withPrefix

      public ConversationFactory withPrefix(ConversationPrefix prefix)
      Sets the ConversationPrefix that prepends all output from all generated conversations. 设置前置到所有生成对话的全部输出前的 ConversationPrefix。

      The default is a NullConversationPrefix; 默认为 NullConversationPrefix；

      参数:
      prefix - The ConversationPrefix to use. 要使用的 ConversationPrefix。
      返回:
      This object. 本对象。

    • withTimeout

      public ConversationFactory withTimeout(int timeoutSeconds)
      Sets the number of inactive seconds to wait before automatically abandoning all generated conversations. 设置在自动放弃所有生成的对话之前等待的不活动秒数。

      The default is 600 seconds (5 minutes). 默认为 600 秒（5 分钟）。

      参数:
      timeoutSeconds - The number of seconds to wait. 要等待的秒数。
      返回:
      This object. 本对象。
